sweep_scope: src/udev.rs: all dmabuf import, feedback and GPU selection paths; live session logs 15:10 and 15:12 IST

src/udev.rs:271 — dmabuf_imported sets the hint only on an exact match
tracked_issues: BUG-2026-11-21-DMABUF-IMPORT — same defect class, opposite direction (forced scanout hint); its feedback tranches are unchanged by this fix
